title: Limen
summary: A deterministic lab for comparing context-selection strategies under fixed budgets.

capabilities.label: Context budgeting
capabilities.detail: Adjust a fixed token budget and inspect exactly what each strategy keeps, clips, or drops.

capabilities.label: Strategy comparison
capabilities.detail: Run two deterministic, versioned strategies against the same authored scenario and compare their metrics.

capabilities.label: Traceable selection
capabilities.detail: Read source provenance, required-fact coverage, contradiction outcomes, and the recorded decision trace.

evidence.description: Rust core and the thin WASM adapter keep selection, metrics, and digesting in one implementation.
The static browser build runs the compiled engine without server, model, or runtime network requests.
Trial downloads preserve the engine's canonical JSON string and result digest byte for byte.
Git-sourced production deployment verified through hosted smoke tests.
